== Notes ==
* Temporarily swap to a [[weapon swap#Energy|high-energy set]] if you think you'll need the boost to have more energy than your target.
* Provided that the prerequisites for additional damage of the skills are met, [[Lightning Bolt]], [[Lightning Hammer]], and [[Lightning Orb]] deal the same amount of damage from Air Magic rank 14 to 16.
